scope: Prospective experimental VerifiedAgent constructor selects registry v3; existing registry default, injected stores, and deployed SupportAgent remain unchanged.

findings: VerifiedAgent explicitly loads config/knowledge/v3.json only when knowledge is None.
KnowledgeStore.load() continues to default to registry v2.
The deployed API continues to construct SupportAgent.
Tests demonstrate scoped v3 Family authority, absence from v2, and explicit v2 injection preservation.
